title: Class location demonstration on a public gas transmission line
line: a 36-inch intrastate gas transmission line in Denton and Collin counties, from the Texas RRC public pipeline dataset
reach_note: The reported reach runs 70.64 miles from the Tarrant/Denton county line to the last Collin/Grayson crossing and includes 6.69 miles along the Grayson County side of the Collin/Grayson county line.
disclaimer: This site demonstrates a class location method on public data. It is not a compliance determination for any operator. Class locations are computed from public building, parcel and pipeline data whose positions and dates carry errors. The pipe attributes behind the 192.609 study years, the 192.611 options and their deadlines are synthetic: the real attributes of the line are not public.
footer: KartaSoft. Demonstration on public data, not a compliance determination for any operator. Pipe attributes are synthetic.
